ReviewProbe.Scope: One independent read-only pass over threshold equivalence and ordering, strict retail hint localization, supplements and mixed-symbol priority, pooled-buffer lifetime, cancellation and framework compatibility. ReviewProbe.ProductApiDependencyAssessment: Accept as shaped: measured decoding work stays in the canonical barcode core, preserves public APIs and deployment, and adds no production dependency. Histogram pass and retained pool capacity are performance tradeoffs to measure.

ChangedDecoders: Global thresholds that produce exactly the same binary pixels are collected once, preserving the first threshold and its candidate priority. A cumulative luminance histogram proves equivalence; adjacent gray cutoffs remain distinct whenever a pixel changes.

Strict EAN/UPC image hints skip unrelated Code 128/39/93 and Expanded localization factories. Ordinary whole-row pitch and retail hypotheses remain available, with parity-constrained fits confined to recovery.

Retail/adaptive run widths use pooled scratch with finally-return on success, failure and cancellation. Existing non-retail localizers receive an owned exact-capacity copy; no borrowed storage reaches decoded results.

Guards, residual limits, parity, checksums, neighboring-row confirmation, add-ons and mixed-symbol behavior remain required. No new public API, production dependency, recognition allowance, hint, oracle or scoring rule.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 219/267 correct positive images versus 219/267 previously; gained: none; previously correct positive images lost: none. Paired negative completion is [30, 30, 30, 30]/31 currently and [30, 30, 30, 30]/31 previously. Retail search costs are measured separately and remain visible. No recognition allowance, hint, oracle or scoring change. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by prior remediation, not an unseen holdout. Invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracles and undeclared QR encoding policies remain unchanged. Shared-host contention and budgets affect results. Stacked DataBar/Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported. These finite workloads do not establish overall superiority.

RegressionProof.Coverage: Existing independent blurred/off-centre UPC photographs, row parity and inversion, array/span single/all and unified scanner, noise rejection, validated gray add-ons and distinct mixed symbols. Existing fractional sampling, Code93 localization and completion contracts also rerun.
RegressionProof.HistoricalProof: UPC recovery and earlier parser/default-scanner experiments remain historical in previous-qualification.json and retained archives. Current framework suites, frozen corpora, timings and PDF417 regressions are rerun.
RegressionProof.FocusedBinaryLimit: Focused validation precedes the source commit. A final extra cancellation checkpoint is covered by full framework qualification against the measured source; it changes no recognition hypothesis.
